item.title: Winter van life: Two ski seasons in the Portes du Soleil living in our campervan
item.description: Living and skiing out of a campervan for the ski season? Most people think we’re a bit mad. Cold weather, van life, surely it’d be miserable? But we’ve now spent 300 nights across two ski seasons in our van, in the Portes du Soleil (PdS). PdS is a huge ski area spanning France and Switzerland that’s home to Avoriaz, Morzine, Châtel and more, and we’d do it again tomorrow.

item.title: Campervan electrics: Do you really need mains power in your campervan?
item.description:
If, like us, you’ve been endlessly researching whether or not to have mains power, then we’re here to explain why you don’t necessarily need this and can get away with using a simple 12-volt system only.

When we were building our campervan, we decided to only have a 12-volt system. We knew we wouldn’t be using high powered appliances and because we were converting a medium wheel base van, we wanted to save space wherever possible.
